verdict.rationale: First-party docs say runes such as `$state` work in `.svelte.js`/`.svelte.ts` modules specifically for "sharing reactive state across your app". They also support reactive class fields and getter-based access, all built in with no external library. A hands-on community report independently confirms that built-in Stores and Context work well for sharing app-wide state. Missing for 10: first-party docs in the pack on the stores and context APIs, and guidance on global-state caveats such as module-level state during SSR.
